'''Dailin''' was a [[Maiden of the Spear]] of the [[Nine Valleys]] [[sept]] of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]]. She was [[Aviendha]]'s [[second-sister]].

== Appearance ==
She had dark red hair and gray eyes.

== Activities ==
Dailin, Aviendha, [[Bain]], [[Chiad]], and [[Jolien]] are some of the last ''[[algai'd'siswai]]'' sent over the [[Spine of the World]] in search of [[He Who Comes With the Dawn]]. [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Egwene al'Vere]], and [[Elayne Trakand]] encountered Aviendha after leaving their grounded ship during their journey towards [[Cairhien]]. She brought them to Dailin, who was wounded, and the other Maidens, and Nynaeve [[Heal]]ed Dailin.{{ref/book|3|38}} The three women left the Aiel and headed towards [[Jurene]].

Shortly after leaving the Maidens, Nynaeve, Egwene, and Elayne were attacked and knocked unconscious. When they awoke, they were being held captive by [[Darkfriend]] bandits and three [[Myrddraal]]. A group of [[Aiel]] arrived, including the five Maidens, and killed the Darkfriends. Nynaeve, Egwene, and Elayne killed the Myrddraal using the [[One Power]].

When the fight was over, Dailin was among the dead.{{ref/book|3|39}} Nynaeve was angered and saddened over "the waste," saying she didn't Heal the girl just so she could die.

Rand mentions her in his list of dead, although she dies before they had even met.{{ref/book|6|26}}

==Errata==
In early printings of the [[The Dragon Reborn]], her sept was incorrectly given as [[Iron Mountain]]. However, Aviendha said that she and Dailin were from the same sept; Aviendha's is consistently given as Nine Valleys.
